name: Unified GetData Full Page Experience
description: Unified GetData Full Page Experience is a unified, full-screen workflow for completing a data-ingestion job from entry points such as Real-Time Hub, Eventhouse, and Eventstream. It guides users through source discovery, connector configuration, preview, optional schema handling and transformation, destination setup, and creation or update of the required ingestion pipeline—with autosave and resume support.

result.nameEs: Experiencia unificada de GetData a pantalla completa
result.descriptionEs: Un flujo a pantalla completa para crear trabajos de ingesta desde Real-Time Hub, Eventhouse o Eventstream: descubrimiento del origen, configuración del conector, vista previa, esquema y transformaciones opcionales, destino y creación del pipeline, con guardado automático y opción de retomar.
